The best trolling motor battery charger depends on whether you're using lithium (LiFePO4) or lead-acid/AGM batteries, and whether your trolling motor runs on 12V, 24V, or 36V.

For most fishing boats, I'd recommend a waterproof, onboard smart charger with 10–15 amps per bank, especially if you regularly fish consecutive days.

Here are the chargers I'd consider, from premium onboard systems to budget-friendly options.

Top trolling motor battery chargers for 2026

1. Best overall — NOCO GENPRO10X3

3 banks · 10A per bank · AGM / LiFePO4

$324.95

Excellent for 24V trolling motors using two 12V batteries, plus a starting battery. Waterproof IP68 design.

2. Best premium — Minn Kota MK-330PCL

3 banks · 10A per bank · AGM / LiFePO4

$290.00

Independent battery chemistry selection, temperature compensation and lithium battery wake-up support. 
Minn Kota
+1

3. Best budget onboard — NOCO GEN5X3

3 banks · 5A per bank · AGM / LiFePO4

$199.95

Good for occasional fishing and overnight charging when speed isn't a priority.

4. Best portable — NOCO GENIUS10

Single output · 10A · 6V/12V

$99.99

Great for a single 12V trolling motor battery when you don't need a permanently installed charger.
